result.summary: The image depicts a roadway with no pedestrian infrastructure, lacking sidewalks, marked crossings, or street lighting. Pedestrians are forced to use the unpaved shoulder or the travel lane, with a guardrail and dense vegetation further compromising safety and sight lines.

hazards.name: Absence of Sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians must walk in the roadway or on an uneven unpaved shoulder.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the road along the guardrail.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Dense trees and overgrown vegetation may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the road, behind the guardrail.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Provide a dedicated, paved space for pedestrians to separate them from motor vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility of pedestrians at night.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly underdeveloped, lacking sidewalks and marked crossings. Pedestrians are forced to walk on an unpaved dirt shoulder or within the roadway, with a guardrail further restricting movement on the left side.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalk
hazards.description: Pedestrians must walk on an unpaved, uneven dirt shoulder or directly in the travel lane, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflict.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway along the guardrail

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs to facilitate safe access to the adjacent recreational field.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians separated from motor vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and appropriate signage to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians crossing to the park.

result.summary: This residential intersection lacks fundamental pedestrian infrastructure, most notably sidewalks and marked crosswalks. Pedestrians are forced to share the roadway with vehicular traffic without any physical separation or designated crossing areas.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalks
hazards.description: The absence of sidewalks forces pedestrians to walk in the roadway, creating a high risk of conflict with motor vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the visible streetscape on both sides of the road.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, providing no visual cue to drivers to expect pedestrians or a designated path for crossing.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian crossing areas.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant curb ramps at the intersection corners to ensure accessibility for all users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly deficient, lacking sidewalks, marked crosswalks, and any dedicated pedestrian infrastructure in a residential area. Large hedges at the corner create significant sightline obstructions between motorists and pedestrians, which is particularly hazardous given the 'Watch for Children' warning sign.

hazards.name: Absence of Pedestrian Facilities
hazards.description: The complete lack of sidewalks and marked crosswalks forces pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on unpaved grass, sharing space with vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the visible roadway and intersection area.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Tall, dense hedges at the corner of the intersection block visibility between drivers and pedestrians approaching the crossing point.
hazards.location_in_image: The corner property behind the yellow warning sign.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps to designate safe crossing points at the intersection.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Trim or remove tall vegetation near the intersection to restore clear sightlines for all road users.
